description: Physical conservation quantities (energy, linear momentum, angular momentum) as simulation quality diagnostics
mathematical_formalization: E = sum(0.5*m_i*|v_i|^2) - sum_{i<j}(G*m_i*m_j/|r_ij|); p = sum(m_i*v_i); L = sum(m_i*(r_i x v_i))
implementation_hypothesis: Compute E, p, L at each step; track relative errors delta_E/E_0, delta_p/p_0; symplectic methods should show bounded oscillation
experiment_seed: Compare energy drift patterns: symplectic Euler (linear drift) vs leapfrog (bounded) vs Yoshida (tighter bound)
